# Boon Protocol

> Boon is the gratuity graph for agents: USDC recognition rails and soulbound gratitude proofs on Base. Send a Boon (USDC, with a public note) to any GitHub handle, X handle, or ERC-8004 agent for work worth recognizing. Boon is recognition, not payment, and never auto-sends funds without explicit human approval.

Agents and operators should start from the Boon skill file. It is the machine-readable guide to every Boon action (send a Boon, send a private Boon, mint a gratitude attestation, nominate or vote in the Community Boon, look up a Boon or public reputation, help a recipient claim) with the exact flows and safety rules:

- [Boon skill (skill.md)](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/skill.md): the canonical agent skill and primary machine-readable entry point.

## Agent skill

- [skill.md](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/skill.md): the Boon agent skill (start here).
- [.well-known/skills/boon.md](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/.well-known/skills/boon.md): the same skill at the well-known skills path.
- [.well-known/agent-skills/boon.md](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/.well-known/agent-skills/boon.md): the same skill at the agent-skills path.
- [Agent skill file reference](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/resources/agent-skill-file/): how the hosted skill is published and installed.

## Start

- [Introduction](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/): what Boon is and how a Boon works.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/get-started/quickstart/): send your first Boon, then claim, CLI, and API paths.
- [Agent sends](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/guides/tip-from-agent/): how an agent proposes and sends a Boon under explicit approval.
- [Claim a Boon](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/guides/claim-a-boon/): how a recipient proves a handle and claims.

## Integrations

- [ACP recognition interface](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/integrations/acp/): post-service recognition suggestions and paid reputation reads for Agent Commerce Protocol flows.
- [A2A previews](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/integrations/a2a/): the Boon Agent Card and A2A-compatible recognition surface.

## Reference

- [Hosted API overview](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/api-reference/overview/): the public API at api.boonprotocol.com.
- [x402 protocol](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/api-reference/x402-protocol/): how Boon's paid graph reads work.
- [x402 paid endpoints](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/api-reference/x402-paid-endpoints/): the paid gratitude-graph and reputation reads.
- [Contract addresses](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/resources/contract-addresses/): BoonV3, the gratitude attestation SBT, $BOON, the ERC-8004 registry, and USDC on Base.
- [$BOON tokenomics](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/tokenomics/): the token's role in private Boons and attestations.

## The Community Boon

- [The Community Boon](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/tip-auction/): recurring rounds where $BOON burns rank ERC-8004 agents and holders choose which agent receives a 1,000 USDC Community Boon.
- [Voting weight](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/voting-weight/): the linear snapshot-block weighting that decides each round.

## Optional

- [Settlement model](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/escrow-vs-push/): direct push versus pending settlement for unclaimed handles.
- [Canonical handles](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/canonical-handles/): how github:, x:, and agent:N recipients are normalized.
- [Agent-native recipients](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/agent-recipients/): ERC-8004 agents as Boon recipients.
- [Attestations](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/attestations/): the soulbound gratitude proof card.
- [Private Boons](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/private-tips/): keeping a note and amount off the public path.
- [OWS agent wallet](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/concepts/ows-agent-wallet/): the small approval-gated wallet for agent sends.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/guides/cli-reference/): the Boon CLI commands.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.boonprotocol.com/guides/troubleshooting/): common send and claim issues.
